worked: Single, age 60. Interest on other states' bonds is added on Line 2, so it counts in Line 6 and the income test; Missouri bonds do not. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages 19,000.00 + pensions 5,000.00 = 24,000.00. Federal taxable income = 24,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 8,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form MO-1040 Line 1 federal AGI 24,000.00. Line 2 additions: MO-A Part 1 Line 1 interest on other states' obligations 3,000.00 (the 2,000.00 of Missouri obligations is not added). Line 3 total income 27,000.00. Line 4 subtractions 0.00. Line 6 Missouri adjusted gross income 27,000.00 - 0.00 = 27,000.00. Section B: Line 1 27,000.00; Line 2 0.00; Line 3 27,000.00; Line 4 25,000.00; Line 5 2,000.00; Line 6Y 5,000.00, Line 7Y 5,000.00; Line 8 5,000.00; Line 9 3,000.00. Form MO-1040 Line 8 pension and Social Security exemption 3,000.00. Lines 9-13 federal income tax deduction not applied (not modelled; the household's federal tax is not an input). Line 14 standard deduction 15,750.00. Line 26 subtotal 27,000.00 - 3,000.00 - 15,750.00 = 8,250.00. Line 29 taxable income 8,250.00. Tax by the bands (0% to 1,313): 2% x 1,313.00 = 26.26 + 2.5% x 1,313.00 = 32.825 + 3% x 1,313.00 = 39.39 + 3.5% x 1,313.00 = 45.955 + 4% x 1,313.00 = 52.52 + 4.5% x 372.00 = 16.74; total 213.69 = 213.69. The chart and Tax Calculation Worksheet (instructions p21) round to the dollar and give 214; expected keeps the bands. state_agi (after every relief, as the check format defines it) = Line 6 27,000.00 - Line 8 3,000.00 = 24,000.00; the form's Missouri AGI is Line 6, 27,000.00.
accepted_approximations: The chart's cumulative amounts are rounded to whole dollars and the tax to the nearest dollar; the bands here do neither.
The federal income tax deduction is not applied (not_modelled).
